summary.zh: 用定位方法产出定位语、竞品卡与上市计划
summary.en: Positioning statement, battlecards and launch plan

description.zh: 按 April Dunford 的定位方法梳理产品定位和目标客户，产出定位语、竞品对比卡和上市计划。适合新产品发布前、进入新细分领域或销售缺少统一说辞时使用。
description.en: Applies April Dunford's positioning method to define the product's place and ICP, producing a positioning statement, battlecards and a go-to-market plan. Use it before a launch or a new segment.
